handoff: Approve: both criteria proven — bundled quick/story pinned by workflowHash (29/8, 42/10) via the store's loader, repo quick/story/release pinned likewise; one minor note for slice 06 (asset tests still parse repo workflow YAML by hand).

findings.title: Asset tests still parse this repo's workflow copies by hand
findings.detail:
Lines 249, 281 and 294 read `.agents/workflows/{story,quick,release}.yaml` with `parse(readFileSync(...))`, not the store's loader. The Plan's prefactor 1 says the asset tests load workflows through the loader instead of parsing YAML themselves. AC1 covers only the bundled templates, and those do go through the loader, so the criterion passes. But once slice 06 rewrites the repo set to take steps from shared files, these raw reads will not see the shared steps and will fail or mislead.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: In slice 06 (or now), read the local copies through `loadWorkflows(<repo root>)` the way process.test.ts does.
